text: INTERPRETER (R28 audit ledger class only): ai_extract_uncertain_i64 and ai_extract_uncertain_f64 now write "effect":"AI" rows to the audit ledger instead of "Net", the class ai_complete already used. The R29 monitor matches that field, so a job whose allowlist excludes AI is now stopped when it calls either builtin, as it already was for ai_complete. http_get and the other network builtins stay Net; what a run computes is unchanged.
